title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Blueberry Cotton K / Raspberry Cotton K Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This confectionery-style duo combines two fairground classics. Blueberry Cotton K pairs ripe blueberry with a light, spun-sugar sweetness, while Raspberry Cotton K brings a sharper fruit edge wrapped in the same soft candy profile. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, each pack pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can load both refills and switch on the device selector. The plug-in format keeps handling simple and mess free. The mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt deliver smooth MTL vapour and fast nicotine satisfaction with clear, candy-led flavour. Try all flavours in the Hayati Pro Ultra Plus range: Explore the collection How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
